no_threshold_price_fill.method: Own integer requote after intervening whole transactions; test exact full-profit-target equality

all_attempts_closed.explanation: Only fast same-slot K=0 cases: no intervening entry price change, hence no 97% guard failure. Delayed scenarios do fail guards; no tape-end closes.

speed_order.explanation: Matched-intent decomposition retained. Later guards reject different trades; quote/output and realized exit differ causally. Breakers additionally select different signals. No enforced PnL monotonicity.
